basic_profile.bio: Avid JRPG enthusiast and dedicated gamer, I first fell in love with the Persona series back in high school. Currently residing in Pune, India, I spend my evenings and weekends immersed in digital worlds. My day job involves software development, which I enjoy but it doesn't quite match the thrill of a new game release. I'm single, and my typical online hours are from 8 PM to midnight, IST. I dislike spoilers and unfinished stories, and I have a soft spot for retro gaming consoles.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and a passion for gaming, my expertise lies in gaming mechanics and retro console restoration. I've spent years self-teaching through online forums and communities, often diving deep into game lore and mechanics.
